component-o.description-s: Mini-Fit Jr. vertical header (5566-02A2, 0039299023), dual row, 2 circuits, 4.20 mm pitch, snap-in plastic pegs, tin, 9.0 A per contact, 600 V, THT for 1.6 mm boards. Board end of the battery cable: 1 BAT+ (V), 2 GND. Mates with Mini-Fit Jr. receptacle 5557 and the off-the-shelf harnesses 215325-102x (150 / 300 / 600 mm, 16 AWG). The same part on both boards.

connector-o.source_s: Molex product sheet 0039299023 and sales drawing 55660021-SD (2-circuit: B 5.4, C 9.40, rows 5.50, pegs 3.00 dia)

mate-o.frame_s: the board connector's footprint frame; the model is built there, so offset and rotation are zero
mate-o.source_s: Molex SD-5557-003: 2-circuit receptacle 5.4 x 9.6 (+2.5 latch) mm, 19.6 mm long, 10.7 mm above the header when seated; two 16 AWG wires (3.1 mm max insulation) 15 mm straight up; keepout adds a finger's reach on the latch side

connector-o.board_area_note_s: bounding rect of courtyard and mate keepout
connector-o.fields_source_s: 9.0 A per contact at 16 AWG, 600 V (Molex sheet on file)
